# csv-profiler

> Profile a CSV or XLSX sheet: inferred types, nulls, duplicates, ranges, top values and warnings, as JSON or a script-free self-contained HTML page. Python package `trysac-csv-profiler`, import name `csv_profiler`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, one runtime dependency (openpyxl 3.x).

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API, errors and limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and data flow
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run the tests and what they must cover
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model with defended and undefended cases
